narrative.overview:
The page is the bar's back wall at night. A warm near-black wood wall carries faint vertical plank seams; on it hang glass neon tubes lettered with the venue's own phrases, illuminated boards that hold the carta and prices, and the owner's night photos pinned at slight angles. Light is the only accent: everything that matters is lit, everything else is wood, cream text and dark glass.

Density is split on purpose. Signs are huge and sparse; boards are dense and scannable, built so a phone visitor finds a price without hunting. Motion has one grammar: light turning on. Nothing slides in, nothing bounces; tubes stutter on, rows light up under the finger, the wall catches the glow.
keyCharacteristics: Dark wood wall (`wall`) with 72px vertical plank seams drawn in CSS, never a photo texture.
Headlines are neon tubes: Quicksand 600 uppercase, warm core plus a five-layer gas halo.
Two gases only: amber (primary) and logo pink (second neon, brand mark, tags).
Content lives on lit boards: thin glowing outline, 18px corners, near-opaque board fill.
Cream for all reading text; amber `glow` for prices and active links.
Real photos only, rounded 18px, hung on the wall with a small tilt and a deep drop shadow.

rules.name: The Light Is the Accent Rule
rules.body: Colour above the cream ladder appears only as light: neon tubes, lit outlines, prices, solid lit buttons. No amber or pink panels, gradients or decorative fills.

rules.name: The Two Gases Rule
rules.body: Amber and pink are the only neon colours. Teal and other street-night hues stay inside photos and never enter CSS.

rules.name: The Tube Is Quicksand Rule
rules.body: Anything that glows is Quicksand 600 uppercase. Baloo 2 never glows; Archivo Narrow never glows.

rules.name: The Words Are the Venue's Rule
rules.body: Neon lines reuse the bar's real phrases and section names. A tube is a headline, never a label above one.

rules.name: The One Light House Rule
rules.body: Every glow is declared in `neon.css`. Components compose `.neon`, `.lit-board`, `.lit-row` and `.wall-spill`; they do not write their own glow.

dos: **Do** set every headline as a neon tube: Quicksand 600 uppercase with `.neon`, one tube per word on the main sign.
**Do** switch light on with stepped timing (`steps(1, end)`) and a stutter on one or two words; light turns on, it never slides.
**Do** put prices and dense lists on a lit board with dashed separators and `glow` tabular prices.
**Do** keep reading text in the cream ladder (`cream`, `cream-soft`, `cream-faint`) on the wall.
**Do** use pills for everything pressable and 18px corners for boards and photos.
**Do** ship photos through the image script with their provenance JSON.
donts: **Don't** add a third neon colour or fill panels with amber or pink.
**Don't** make Baloo 2 or Archivo Narrow glow, and don't set neon in lowercase.
**Don't** use slide-in, fade-up or scroll-reveal entrances.
**Don't** use hard or offset shadows; shadows are long, soft and dark, or they are light.
